meta.paths: src_text and digest_ref are relative to lesson-lab/; digest_ref is file:line of the digest card
meta.order: lessons are listed per grade in teaching order: site section (month) order, units by lesson number, calendar lessons last as on the site; sequence[grade] includes lessons shared from other grades
meta.unit_order: lesson slot within its unit (1-based); gender-split pair shares a slot; unit_size = number of slots
meta.effort: per-lesson weight from words (1.0/1.2/1.4/1.6 at <1000/<1600/<2400/2400+), +0.2 if 35+ slides, load (-0.2..+0.4), sensitivity (high +0.3), double-period +0.3, assets-missing +0.2, grade adaptation +0.2; package S < 4.0 <= M <= 7.0 < L
